GPU: fast clustering on the data

rs_fast_cluster_gpu.Rd

GPU equivalent of bixverse::rs_fast_cluster_sc. Coarsens the cells with k-means on the GPU, builds a graph over the centroids (a kNN graph with one of the symmetrisations, or the cell-mediated graph) and runs Louvain or Leiden on it. The community of each centroid is propagated back to its cells. With n_seeds > 1 every resolution is run once per seed, the labels come from the seed with the lowest mean conductance and stability metrics across the seeds are returned. Everything after stage one stays on the CPU.

Usage

rs_fast_cluster_gpu(
  embd,
  resolutions,
  fc_params,
  n_seeds,
  seed,
  verbose,
  backend = "wgpu"
)

Arguments

embd

Numeric matrix. The embedding, cells x features.

resolutions

Numeric vector. The resolutions to iterate through.

fc_params

Named list. See params_sc_fast_cluster_gpu(). Carries the GPU k-means keys (k_means_iter, k_means_init, fixed, quantise) alongside the fast clustering ones.

n_seeds

Integer. Number of seeds per resolution. 1L runs a single pass without stability metrics.

seed

Integer. For reproducibility.

verbose

Integer. 0L - quiet; 1L - normal verbosity; 2L - detailed verbosity.

backend

String. "wgpu" or "mlx" (Apple Silicon, needs a build with the MLX backend, see mlx_available()). MLX ignores fixed and quantise.

Value

A list with the following elements:

  • membership - List with one integer membership vector per resolution (0-indexed).

  • k_means_cluster - Integer vector with the k-means centroid per cell (0-indexed).

  • centroids - Numerical matrix with the k-means centroids.

  • stats - NULL for n_seeds = 1L, otherwise a list with mean_ari, median_ari, mean_conductance, median_conductance and mean_n_comms, one value per resolution.
